status: authored 2026-10-22 (offline: table, generator, checks; NOTHING applied to any world, not seen in game)
owner_brief: the owner, 2026-10-22: "for the economy we are diving back into the same mistake adding trainers people may never see... i like th emines idea thats good add trainers there"
what_this_is: The trainers who work the three long mine networks (data/mine_networks.json). Each slot names a LEVEL and either a walk distance from the adit along the main line or the stope of that level; tools/mine_crews.py picks the cell from the network's own geometry (a straight three-wide stretch, on a side lane, facing toward the adit; or a free stope cell facing the stope's entry). The table owns who, what they fight with and what they say; the geometry owns the cell.
level_rule: A network's band is the gym level band of what a player reaches there, and a member's levels rise with depth inside it. Normal teams are 2 to 3 Pokemon for the crew, 4 for the foreman and 5 for the Shift Boss. A Challenge team is the Normal one with the same levels and a held item on each member, plus one more member for the foreman, the Shift Boss and some of the crew (Normal's length or one more).
challenge_rule: challenge.items[i] is the held item of Normal member i; challenge.extra, when present, is a further member after the last. Nothing else differs, so a Challenge team has the same levels as Normal's and an ace at the same level (tools/challenge_mode.py challenge_rct).
types: Rock, Ground, Steel or Fire on every member (a type of either slot). Species are the ones data/spawns.json or data/trainers.json already carry; tools/mine_crews.py check reads each against the Cobblemon 1.8 jar's learnset and types when the jar is on the machine.
money: None authored. CobbleDollars pays 0.28125 * S^2 on average a win, S the losing team's level sum (data/markets.json); tools/mine_crews.py purses prints them.

networks.name: The Ridgeback Workings
networks.band_why: The nearest town is gym4_town (Erika's, 700 blocks); a player here has three badges and is walking Route 4 (trainer levels 26 to 33, data/trainers.json) toward a leader whose ace is 35 (generation_contract.gym_ace_levels). The crew runs 27 on the first level to 33, and the Shift Boss is 34, a level under Erika's ace.

crew.name: Pit Boy Callum

lines.pre: New on the ridge? Then you pay the toll. A fight for the first level of the Workings.
lines.player_win: Fair. Go on down. The iron is deeper than the coal.
lines.player_loss: Back up the adit and try again when you are rested.

crew.lesson: Rock and Ground at the mouth: Water and Grass hit both.
crew.why: the first of the crew, 100 blocks in along the adit drift, where every player passes

crew.name: Hauler Reese

lines.pre: Haulage has the right of way on this line. Beat me or wait for the cart.
lines.player_win: The cart can wait. You may not stand in front of it again.
lines.player_loss: Stand clear of the rail, miner.

crew.lesson: A big Rock body and a Fire/Ground one: two different answers.
crew.why: the far end of the adit drift on the first level, before the crosscuts to the first stope

crew.name: Dumper Sorrel

lines.pre: You came down the incline like the rest of them. Same toll.
lines.player_win: That is the second level, then. The foreman waits further in.
lines.player_loss: Get out of the way of the dump.

crew.lesson: Stealth Rock on the field punishes a team that switches a lot.
crew.why: second level main drift, where the incline from the first level lands the walk

crew.name: Stope Hand Garrick

lines.pre: Wide room, plenty of ore, and it is my face. You want it? Win it.
lines.player_win: Take the seam on the left wall. I was never going to work it.
lines.player_loss: My face. My rock. Go and dig somewhere else.

crew.lesson: A Steel body that shrugs off Rock; bring Fire or Fighting.
crew.why: the second level's stope, a room six players work at once; the one who holds it holds the best vein

crew.name: Timberer Neve

lines.pre: I set every frame on this level myself. You walk under my timber, you answer to me.
lines.player_win: Mind the sets. The roof is older than either of us.
lines.player_loss: Those frames hold. You, I am less sure of.

crew.lesson: Three bodies and three answers: do not lead with one type.
crew.why: third level, on the long drift from the incline to the shaft

crew.name: Shot-Firer Dax

lines.pre: Fire in the hole. Or it will be, once you have lost to me.
lines.player_win: No flash, no bang. You are all right.
lines.player_loss: That is how a charge goes off, miner.

crew.lesson: A slow Fire/Rock wall, a fast Ground striker and an Electric/Steel one.
crew.why: fourth level, past the second shaft where the drifts begin to run long

crew.name: Pump Hand Tessa

lines.pre: Water comes up from below, and it has to be pumped. I pump. You pay.
lines.player_win: Then you may use my ladder. Do not drip on it.
lines.player_loss: Dry yourself out and come back.

crew.lesson: Water or Grass would do, but all three are weak to a different one.
crew.why: fifth level, on the main line past the foot of the fourth level's shaft

crew.name: Foreman Hale Corbin

lines.pre: I run the third shift on the Ridgeback. Nobody works my stope without my say-so.
lines.player_win: You have the say-so. Do not tell the Shift Boss I gave it.
lines.player_loss: Back to the surface. Come down again when you can lift your own pick.

crew.lesson: The foreman leads with Ground and Steel and finishes with Fire.
crew.why: the stope of the fifth level, the middle of the Workings and the room the crew meets in

crew.name: Deep Hand Orrin

lines.pre: Down here the lamps go out first and the miners second. Show me your light.
lines.player_win: Your light is steadier than mine. Take the lower drift.
lines.player_loss: No light, no business here. Go up.

crew.lesson: Deeper means higher levels: this is the first of the 32s.
crew.why: sixth level, on the main line between the two long drifts

crew.name: Lamp Tender Sabine

lines.pre: I keep the lamps, and I know every dark corner of this level. Including this one.
lines.player_win: Take a lantern from my tray. You have earned it.
lines.player_loss: Mind your head on the way up.

crew.lesson: A sand setter, a fast Fire attacker and a Steel/Psychic wall.
crew.why: sixth level, further along the main line than the previous hand

crew.name: Face Breaker Joss

lines.pre: Last drift before the Boss's chamber. I break the face here, and nobody slips past.
lines.player_win: Then go in. The Boss is not as kind as I am.
lines.player_loss: Not today. The face is mine.

crew.lesson: The last guard before the Shift Boss; three bodies that resist each other's weaknesses.
crew.why: the last level's main line, in front of the stope at the end of the Workings

crew.name: Shift Boss Maren Tull

lines.pre: Seven levels, and I am at the bottom of every one. The Shift Boss keeps the lowest stope. Show me what you brought down.
lines.player_win: The Workings are yours to dig. Mind the roof, and come up before the whistle.
lines.player_loss: The whistle blew for you, miner. Go up.

crew.lesson: Five bodies, no weakness repeated twice: bring a Water, a Grass and a Fighting answer.
crew.why: the deepest stope of the Workings, where the best ore is and a miner must pass the Boss to take it

networks.name: The Hollow Seam
networks.band_why: The nearest settlement is Bridgekeep (gorge_hamlet), which sits between Sabrina and Blaine; a player here has six badges and is on Route 7 (trainer levels 41 to 48, data/trainers.json), under Blaine's ace of 50. The crew runs 41 to 47 and the Shift Boss is 48, the top of Route 7.

crew.name: Rope Boy Eddin

lines.pre: Copper goes out of the Seam and bridge-money comes in. Nobody walks it for free.
lines.player_win: Go on, then. Mind the rope on the incline.
lines.player_loss: Come back when you have a better team.

crew.lesson: Two Ground bodies: Water, Grass and Ice.
crew.why: the first drift of the Seam, where both adits' walks meet the same ground

crew.name: Culvert Hand Perrin

lines.pre: The gorge floods the low drifts in a wet year. I keep the culverts clear, and I keep this road.
lines.player_win: Then the road is yours. Keep to the rail.
lines.player_loss: Keep your feet dry and come again.

crew.lesson: A Ground tank and a Bug/Rock one that sets Stealth Rock.
crew.why: the first level's long main drift, before its crosscuts

crew.name: Surveyor Wynn

lines.pre: My chain says this seam runs to the gorge wall. My eyes say you are in my sightline.
lines.player_win: Reading confirmed. Walk on.
lines.player_loss: Re-measure and try again.

crew.lesson: Two Steel bodies that Ground and Fire both hit.
crew.why: second level main line where the first level's incline lands

crew.name: Bucket Hand Fern

lines.pre: Lapis in this wall, and I saw it first. You want it, you fight for it.
lines.player_win: Take the blue. I have all I can carry.
lines.player_loss: Mine. All mine. Go find your own wall.

crew.lesson: Two Rock bodies, one fast and one bulky.
crew.why: the second level's stope, a room the whole crew passes through

crew.name: Lapis Cutter Mara

lines.pre: A cut stone does not scratch. Neither do I. Shall we find out which?
lines.player_win: A scratch. Well. Go on through.
lines.player_loss: Not a mark on me.

crew.lesson: A Steel/Rock wall resisted by almost everything; Fighting and Ground cut it.
crew.why: third level, on the drift that joins the two shafts

crew.name: Shoreman Tobias

lines.pre: I shore up what the water takes. This drift has taken two shores already. Three is a bad number.
lines.player_win: The shore holds. So do you.
lines.player_loss: Another shore lost. Stand back.

crew.lesson: Three types in three bodies: a Fire/Ground, a Steel, a Ground.
crew.why: fourth level, past the second incline

crew.name: Pumpman Linus

lines.pre: The pump runs on a boiler and a bad temper. Both are hot. Both are mine.
lines.player_win: Cool down. Take the ladder to the next level.
lines.player_loss: Too much steam. Back to the surface.

crew.lesson: Fire pair: Water, Ground and Rock hit them hard.
crew.why: fifth level, on the long drift above the foreman's stope

crew.name: Foreman Ada Pellam

lines.pre: I run the Hollow Seam's day shift and I know every miner on it. I do not know you. Show me.
lines.player_win: Good enough for the day shift. The Shift Boss is below.
lines.player_loss: Not good enough. Go up and sleep.

crew.lesson: Rock/Ground first, a Steel/Electric second, then Ground/Steel and a slow Fire.
crew.why: the stope of the fifth level, the middle of the Seam

crew.name: Seam Hand Cormac

lines.pre: I follow the copper where it goes, and it goes down. Down is my business.
lines.player_win: You follow it too. Fine, we dig together.
lines.player_loss: You have a long way to dig yet.

crew.lesson: A flier-looking Ground, a Rock/Fire and a Steel/Psychic.
crew.why: sixth level, on the drift below the foreman's stope

crew.name: Drill Hand Hester

lines.pre: My drill never stops, and neither do I. Ask the rock.
lines.player_win: You stopped me. I did not think anyone could.
lines.player_loss: The drill wins, as always.

crew.lesson: A sand tank, a Dark/Fire one and a Fire one that hits hard.
crew.why: the last level's drift on the way to the Boss's stope

crew.name: Blast Hand Rook

lines.pre: Stand back, I have charged this face. Or win and I will let you watch.
lines.player_win: Watch, then. It is a good one.
lines.player_loss: Stand back. Further.

crew.lesson: The last guard before the Boss: bulky Rock, a special Fire/Ghost and a Steel/Rock wall.
crew.why: the last level's main line, in front of the Boss's stope

crew.name: Shift Boss Ilsa Draycott

lines.pre: Seven levels down, and my name is on the lamp. Beat me and the Seam is yours.
lines.player_win: The Seam is yours. Leave the lamps lit and come up before dark.
lines.player_loss: The lamp stays lit for me. Go up.

crew.lesson: A Rock/Ground opener, then Steel, Fire/Ground, Ground/Steel and Fire: Water and Fighting answer most.
crew.why: the deepest stope of the Hollow Seam, the end of the longest level and the best vein

networks.name: The Old Craters Drift
networks.band_why: The nearest town is Fossick (mining_town), in the Craters 912 blocks from Cinderlee, Blaine's town; a player here has six or seven badges and is on Route 7 or 8 (trainer levels 41 to 53, data/trainers.json) toward a leader whose ace is 50 (Blaine) or 55 (Giovanni). The crew runs 45 to 51 and the Shift Boss is 52, inside Route 8's top of 53.

crew.name: Tipper Rowan

lines.pre: Coal and iron out of the Old Drift since before the cone woke. I tip the carts. Care to tip me?
lines.player_win: Tipped. Go down, the iron is below.
lines.player_loss: The cart goes on. You do not.

crew.lesson: A slow Fire/Rock and a fast Ground: different answers.
crew.why: the adit drift 110 blocks in, where every player passes

crew.name: Hauler Bram

lines.pre: The rails are mine to run. Step off them or fight me.
lines.player_win: Off the rail, then, and good luck.
lines.player_loss: I said off the rail.

crew.lesson: A heavy Ground/Rock and a Fire tank.
crew.why: further along the adit drift on the first level

crew.name: Shoreman Ida

lines.pre: I hold the roof up. You walk under it. That is a debt, miner.
lines.player_win: Debt settled. Go carefully.
lines.player_loss: The roof is still there. Think about that.

crew.lesson: A fast Ground/Steel and a Rock/Steel wall.
crew.why: second level, where the first incline lands

crew.name: Stope Hand Garrick

lines.pre: Fine room. Six of you could work it, and none of you will while I am here.
lines.player_win: Work it. I will watch.
lines.player_loss: Mine. Next.

crew.lesson: Fire/Ground and Rock/Steel: Water and Fighting.
crew.why: the second level's stope

crew.name: Timberer Neve

lines.pre: These frames carried the Drift for a century. They can carry one more fight.
lines.player_win: The frames held. Barely.
lines.player_loss: Rotten timber, rotten team.

crew.lesson: Steel, Fire and Ground in one team.
crew.why: third level, on the long drift between the incline and the shaft

crew.name: Shot-Firer Dax

lines.pre: Fire in the hole. This time I mean the Pokemon.
lines.player_win: Quiet. Good. Keep it quiet.
lines.player_loss: Fire in the hole.

crew.lesson: A coal Rock/Fire and an Electric/Steel: Water and Ground answer both.
crew.why: fourth level, on the long drift past the shaft

crew.name: Pump Hand Tessa

lines.pre: Hot below the fifth level. Hot enough to melt a pump. Hot enough to melt you.
lines.player_win: You did not melt. Go on.
lines.player_loss: Melted. As I said.

crew.lesson: Dark/Ground, Fire and Steel/Psychic.
crew.why: fifth level, near the foot of the shaft

crew.name: Foreman Hale Voss

lines.pre: I run the Old Drift and have since the first shaft went down. Nobody works it without the foreman's nod.
lines.player_win: You have my nod. Do not waste it.
lines.player_loss: No nod. Up the ladder.

crew.lesson: Ground, Steel, Fire and Rock: four answers needed.
crew.why: the fifth level's stope, the middle of the Drift

crew.name: Deep Hand Orrin

lines.pre: Below the sixth level the air is thin and the rock is warm. I like it that way.
lines.player_win: Then you can take the heat. Go on.
lines.player_loss: Too hot for you, miner.

crew.lesson: Sand, slow Fire and a fast drill: a hard fight for a six-badge team.
crew.why: sixth level, on the main line between the two long drifts

crew.name: Lamp Tender Sabine

lines.pre: Every lamp in the Drift is mine. I light them, I trim them, and I keep them from going out. Mind your own.
lines.player_win: Your light is steadier than most. Go on.
lines.player_loss: Your light has gone out.

crew.lesson: A Fire/Ghost glass cannon behind a Rock wall.
crew.why: seventh level, on the long main line

crew.name: Face Breaker Joss

lines.pre: Last drift before the Boss's chamber. I break the face, and no one slips by.
lines.player_win: Go in. The Boss is not kind.
lines.player_loss: Not today. The face is mine.

crew.lesson: The last guard before the Shift Boss; three heavy bodies.
crew.why: the eighth level's main line, in front of the stope at the end of the Drift

crew.name: Shift Boss Maren Kell

lines.pre: Eight levels. I have worked every one and I keep the last. The Shift Boss does not lose a stope. Show me what you brought down.
lines.player_win: The Drift is yours. Mind the roof, and be up before the whistle.
lines.player_loss: The whistle blew for you. Go up.

crew.lesson: A Rock/Dark opener, then Ground/Rock, Fire/Ghost, Steel/Rock and Fire/Ground: Water, Fighting and Ground answer most.
crew.why: the deepest stope of the Old Craters Drift, where the richest ore is and a miner must pass the Boss to take it
